Strategy: Net Reserve Stands at $35 Billion, All Bitcoin Holdings Unencumbered Strategy said its Net Reserve now stands at $35 billion, with all of its bitcoin holdings unencumbered. During the 2022 bear market, its Net Reserve was negative and one-third of its BTC was pledged as collateral. The company said it survived that downturn and emerged stronger, adding that its "conviction and optionality have never been stronger." — link

Highlight Clip: Arthur Hayes: Why Is Bitcoin Sold First When Markets Turn Risk-Off? Arthur Hayes: Why Is Bitcoin Sold First When Markets Turn Risk-Off? On November 17, 2026, Maelstrom CIO Arthur Hayes said on the New Era Finance podcast that Bitcoin and crypto remain risk assets. Because crypto markets operate around the clock, investors facing losses elsewhere often sell their readily accessible crypto holdings first to meet margin calls or repay bank loans. This leaves Bitcoin exposed to selling during global risk-off events, particularly when stress is concentrated in technology stocks. Even if investors expect eventual bailouts to drive prices higher, they may still need cash now to avoid liquidation in less liquid positions. WuBlockchain notes that Arthur Hayes has a mixed track record of market predictions and frequently revises his views. Readers should focus on his analytical framework rather than treating specific price targets or timelines as investment guidance. — link

Kraken BTC Pricing Anomaly Briefly Sends Quote to $27,000; Exchange Confirms No Breach and Executed Trades Stand Kraken stated in a post that starting around 20:00 UTC on November 20, Canadian dollar (CAD) trading pairs on the platform experienced heavy selling pressure, pushing prices well below other external markets. Kraken stated that its platform processed every order correctly and that its security teams found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts, confirming that all executed trades will stand. Earlier, following the anomaly in which Kraken's BTC/CAD pair briefly dropped to roughly 40,000 CAD (around $27,000), Blockstream co-founder Adam Back attributed the dislocation to a likely market maker glitch and a sharp deviation in Kraken's local spot USDC/CAD rate from the actual FX rate of approximately 1.434. — link

Buterin said CZ's accent had been made to sound roughly three times more foreign than he remembered. He also criticized the production for reinforcing the stereotype that people travel to foreign countries only to engage in suspicious activities.
